foundation: C22: Account, appearance and privacy presentation
identity: Black/white with burgundy and burnt orange support.
domain_style: Field-readable black/white identity, burgundy sensitive-action context, burnt-orange appearance guidance and large clear targets.

panels.label: Rider identity
panels.specimen: Card "Rider profile", generic person outline icon, EMPTY name skeleton, small label "Contact details"; SECONDARY "Edit contact details". Orange BOARD note "Identity changes use a separate review". No rider initials/phone/vehicle/verified badge/document photo.

panels.label: Appearance
panels.specimen: Card "Appearance", THREE choices "System", "Light", "Dark". Select matching board theme only. Below "On this device"; orange note "System follows device appearance". Use black selected light / off-white selected dark with dark inverse text.

panels.label: Sensitive rider summaries
panels.specimen: Card "Private details", rows "Identity document" and "UPI", values ONLY "••••••••". Small burgundy contextual label "Sensitive information". Orange BOARD note "UPI masking proposed". No IDs/digits/document photograph/eye control or all-private assurance.

panels.label: Protected account actions
panels.specimen: Card "Account deletion unavailable", body "Finish the assigned delivery before continuing." SECONDARY "View delivery". Below a separate outline "Sign out" action. Orange BOARD note "Illustrative active-delivery refusal". Burgundy is context, no Delete now, eligibility/success/paid/erasure checkmark.

account_contract: Identity must come from current account/role sources; loading, missing and failure are not a fabricated name, avatar, verified status or access grant.
Separate public/business identity, private contact, authentication credentials and financial destination details by app domain.
Masking minimizes display exposure; it is not encryption, storage security, access authorization or a privacy compliance guarantee. Do not mask inaccessible data and then claim permission is safe.
Owned editing may require actual raw values; summary masking is distinct from explicit editing and reviewed destination/identity changes. Avoid invented reveal/copy/security controls.
Appearance follows supported provider modes. Marketplace/Admin two states; Seller/Delivery/Associate three. Associate selector and Admin binding are proposed UI work.
System mode is a preference, resolved brightness follows the OS. Explicit Light/Dark boards select their matching mode, not System.
Current preferences are local device storage, not account/server/cloud sync. Applied state and persistence success are separate; errors need truthful feedback.
Recheck captured account/session/entity/route ownership after confirmations and asynchronous results. Preserve existing Delivery/Admin guards and Marketplace deletion guards.
Sign-out, account deletion, credential change and cache/data clearing are separate actions with different outcomes. No all-devices logout or canceled-in-flight promise.
Deletion review/acknowledgement is not eligibility. Refusal, unknown outcome, partial failure and confirmed completion remain distinct. Server business/retention policy governs deletion.
Only Marketplace/Delivery deletion entries are evidenced in these screens. Do not add identical seller/associate/admin self-delete controls merely for visual consistency.
Do not reproduce unverified encryption/sharing/verification/MFA/biometric/privacy compliance or complete-erasure claims. No real or synthetic PII/credential values in specimens.
Accessible selected labels and full targets, clear consequence text, focus restoration and status announcements need runtime validation; generated boards do not certify accessibility/security.
implementation_status: Design assets/docs only. No app/package runtime, pubspec, navigation or backend changed by this task.
limits: Raster proposals; no runtime/accessibility certification or pixel-exact color/geometry claim.
